title: Channel-Adaptive Region Adjacency Graph Carriers for Semantic Image Communication
abstract: arXiv:2609.14616v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Semantic image communication seeks to preserve task-relevant scene structure under limited channel resources, but carriers are often dense latent tensors or grid-aligned semantic layouts that do not explicitly encode region-level relations. This work introduces a segmentation-derived region adjacency graph (RAG) carrier, termed channel-adaptive RAG (CA-RAG), for joint source-channel coding-style image communication. Nodes store interpretable region attributes, edges preserve adjacency, channel-adaptive graph simplification (CGS) controls the node budget, and semantic belief propagation refines noisy graph embeddings before diffusion-based reconstruction. On Cityscapes, pre-channel RAG payloads are several times smaller than compressed class-index layouts in a 2,000-image study. Under additive white Gaussian noise at signal-to-noise ratios from 0 to 15 dB, CA-RAG reports higher semantic consistency than deep joint source-channel coding

translated_title: 面向语义图像通信的信道自适应区域邻接图载体
translated_abstract: 语义图像通信旨在有限的信道资源下保留与任务相关的场景结构，但现有载体通常是稠密的潜在张量或网格对齐的语义布局，无法显式编码区域级关系。本工作提出了一种基于分割的区域邻接图（RAG）载体，称为信道自适应RAG（CA-RAG），用于联合信源信道编码式的图像通信。节点存储可解释的区域属性，边保留邻接关系，信道自适应图简化（CGS）控制节点预算，语义置信传播在基于扩散的重建之前对含噪图嵌入进行精炼。在一项针对2000张图像的研究中，在Cityscapes数据集上，信道前的RAG载荷比压缩的类别索引布局小数倍。在信噪比从0到15 dB的加性高斯白噪声下，CA-RAG表现出比深度联合信源信道编码更高的语义一致性。
tldr: 本文提出信道自适应区域邻接图（CA-RAG）作为语义图像通信的新载体，通过可解释的区域属性存储、邻接关系保持、信道自适应图简化和语义置信传播机制，在噪声信道下以更小的载荷实现了比深度联合信源信道编码更高的语义一致性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a channel-adaptive region adjacency graph (CA-RAG) carrier for semantic image communication, which achieves higher semantic consistency than deep joint source-channel coding under noisy channels while using several times smaller payloads, by combining interpretable region attributes, adjacency preservation, channel-adaptive graph simplification, and semantic belief propagation.
